description.value: Pemberton Valley Supermarket is the community grocery store in downtown Pemberton, located in the village centre about 25 minutes north of Whistler on Highway 99. It is a full-service store with deli, bakery, meat, and produce departments, and offers online ordering with curbside pickup or delivery. Touring cyclists passing through the Sea-to-Sky corridor will find a well-stocked stop with credit and debit card acceptance.
